decisions.reason: 李延寔 is Yanshi (寔); Yanbao would require 寶 and is not in the Chinese.
祈白三寶 is to pray and announce to the Three Jewels; 白 is the verb, not the color white.
尖山侯淵 is Hou Yuan, Marquis of Jianshan; 侯 is the surname, as the next unit's 侯淵 confirms.
The literal 'Yuan Yuan' doubles 淵 and drops the surname 侯 present in 侯淵.
The quoted 侯淵 is Hou Yuan, not an invented Yuan Yuan.
The same quoted 侯淵 must be Hou Yuan in the literal.
討斬之 follows both 僧強 and 蔡伯龍; 之 is the rebels as a group, not Qiang alone.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0045 shows Yuan Yuan was created only by doubling 淵 and dropping the surname 侯; no such alias is in 侯淵.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003 restores 暉業 as Huiye; the English personal name Ye was created by truncating that name.
Accepted r0003 restores the title-plus-name 濟陰王暉業; Prince Ye of Jiyin dropped Hui.
Accepted r0005 restores 小新成 as Xiao Xincheng; Lesser Xin Prince Cheng invented a princely title not in the Chinese.
Accepted r0007 restores 邢杲 as Xing Gao; Xing Luo came only from the bad transcription.
Accepted r0011 restores abbreviated 杲 as Gao; Luo is not a reading of that graph.
Accepted r0013 restores 薛琡 as Xue Shu; Zan would be 瓚, not 琡.
Revised r0034 keeps 臨淮王 as Prince of Linhuai; Prince Huai of Linhuai was created by splitting the fief name.
Accepted r0029 shows 東中郎將 is not Palace Attendant; the English office label still carried Palace from that error.
Accepted r0041 restores 李延寔 as Li Yanshi; Yanbao invents 寶.
Revised r0034 restores 臨淮王 as Prince of Linhuai; Huai is not a posthumous name.
